16 | Intuitions V | caster | - | self | I
17 | Spirit Walk II | self | 10 min/lvl | self | U
18 | Illusionsight | caster | 1 min/lvl | self | U
19 | Meditative Sleep | caster | varies | self | U
20 | Spiritual Vision | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
25 | Spirit Walk III | self | 10 min/lvl | self | U
30 | True Lore | 1 target | - | 100' | P
50 | Spiritual Vision True | caster | 1 rnd/lvl | varies | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster gains a special bonus of +25 to one Meditation Static Maneuver
performed next round.
@@ 2
Caster can see 100’ on a normal night as if it were daylight.
@@ 3
For the duration of the spell the caster receives a special bonus of +30 to
RRs versus outside corruption influences.
@@ 4
Detects ''evil'' in an animate or inanimate target; caster can concentrate on
a 5’R area each round.
@@ 5
Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen within the next minute if
he takes a specified action.
@@ 6
Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before returning. The
caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell
to work.
@@ 7
Caster can sense if there is a disharmony in the ''natural order'' of the
world within the area of effect. The caster gets an impression of something
wrong, but not the reason why. For example, the caster could sense that
magical effects were altering nature, or that some curse lay upon the area,
etc.
@@ 8
As Nightvision, except any darkness can been seen through. Also, no light is
needed for this spell to work.
@@ 9
Detects any invisible object in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on
a different 5’R each round.
@@ 10
As Intuitions I, except caster may gaze 2 minutes into the future.
@@ 11
Caster’s spirit leaves his body to wander the physical world, and can travel
at normal walking speed for the duration of this spell. While in spirit form,
the caster is invisible, and cannot affect the physical world in any way. The
caster’s spirit cannot do anything that his normal physical body cannot do
(e.g., fly, walk through walls, etc.). If the caster’s spirit has not returned
to the caster’s body before the end of the spell, the caster must make a RR
versus his own level or his spirit cannot rejoin with his body (i.e., he
dies). This RR must be made every minute past the end of the spell, in which
the caster is not back in his body.
@@ 12
Awakens caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., sleep spell, sleeping drug,
etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.
@@ 13
As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.
@@ 14
As Sense Disharmony, except for the duration and range. Caster can concentrate
on a different area each round.
@@ 15
Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that he can normally see. In
addition, he suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not
invisible to him).
@@ 16
As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 5 minutes into the future.
@@ 17
As Spirit Walk I, except that caster may move at twice his normal walking
pace, and he may float/fly at a rate of 10’ per round.
@@ 18
Caster can see through any visual illusions. This does not affect any of the
other senses.
@@ 19
During normal sleep, the caster may make Awareness maneuvers (that are not
based solely on sight), at no penalty.
@@ 20
As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.
@@ 25
As Spirit Walk II, except that the caster may move at up to four times his
normal walking pace, and he may pass through non-magical substances (e.g.,
walls) at a rate of 10’ per round.
@@ 30
Caster can ascertain exact nature, origin, purpose, and history of any 1
''holy item''; it allows caster to visualize all who have possessed the item.
@@ 50
Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.
